title: PhysScope: Agentic Multimodal Physics Reasoning with Grounded Visual Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.23010v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can correctly interpret physics diagrams yet apply constraints outside the states or conditions in which they hold, causing premise errors to propagate through subsequent calculations. We introduce PhysScope, an inference-time visual harness that supports self-correction of these scope mismatches without updating model weights. PhysScope enables the model to link physical scopes directly to its visual observations and explicitly constructs derived views to support reasoning. The harness imposes explicit constraints on state distinctions, conditions, and physical scopes during model reasoning, and checks agent-proposed revisions against sources and scopes. Accepted revisions invalidate registered dependents, thereby maintaining scope-aware working memory. translated_title: PhysScope：基于接地视觉记忆的智能体多模态物理推理
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）虽然能够正确解读物理示意图，却常常在这些约束所适用的状态或条件之外应用它们，导致前提错误在后续计算中不断传播。我们提出了 PhysScope，这是一个推理时的视觉辅助框架，无需更新模型权重即可支持对这类范围错配的自我修正。PhysScope 使模型能够将物理范围直接关联到其视觉观察，并显式构建派生视图以支持推理。该框架在模型推理过程中对状态区分、条件和物理范围施加显式约束，并依据来源和范围对智能体提出的修改进行核查。被接受的修改会使已注册的依赖项失效，从而维持具有范围感知的工作记忆。在 PhysAlign 基准上，PhysScope 在所有六个被评估的 VLM 中均取得了比直接求解更高的解题分数。使用 Gemini-3.8-flash 时，其表现优于 Canvas-CoT 基线……
tldr: PhysScope 是一个推理时的视觉辅助框架，通过将物理约束与视觉观察直接关联并维护范围感知的工作记忆，使视觉-语言模型无需更新权重即可自我修正物理推理中的范围错配错误。
en_tdlr: PhysScope is an inference-time visual harness that grounds physical constraints in visual observations and maintains scope-aware working memory, enabling VLMs to self-correct scope mismatches in physics reasoning without updating model weights.
